next.reason: 1985: 'Literal-2 or the content of the data item referenced by identifier-2 indicates the character(s) delimiting the move. If the SIZE phrase is used, the content of the complete data item ... is moved' and a figurative-constant delimiter 'is a single character nonnumeric literal'. §2023:14.9.43.4 GR1 repeats both sentences word for word, adding only the current length of a dynamic-length identifier-1 (a 2023-only item kind). The single-character figurative delimiter is carried by §2023:14.9.43.4 GR2 ('an implicit one character data item whose usage shall be the same as the usage of identifier-3, either display or national'; display is the only usage a 1985 identifier-3 can have) and §2023:8.3.3.6.4 GR3 ('When a figurative constant is other than ALL literal-1, the length of the string is one character'). Every 1985 program means the same.
